blockers.description: The authoritative capability and task registries contain 657 dangling source-requirement references covering 278 distinct IDs, none resolved by the supersession map.
The production validator and challenge suite omit those fields and therefore issue a false zero-defect PASS.
The designated pre-repair Graphify backup omits 34 AFFiNE reference files that predate the backup, so it is not a complete recovery image.
